name: Neutrino-4
summary: Neutrino-4 searches for metre-scale oscillations at the compact SM-3 research reactor in Dimitrovgrad. Its movable segmented detector compares antineutrino spectra across baselines and has reported a sterile-mixing interpretation that remains unconfirmed.
detection_principle: Gadolinium-loaded segmented liquid scintillator detects inverse beta decay. Moving the detector changes the source distance; ratios across position and energy are used to seek a periodic L/E pattern.

status.label: Research and development
status.evidence: A funded follow-up project documents detector-upgrade work; exact current reactor running is not inferred.

timeline.event: Detector upgrade and follow-up validation project

key_parameters.value: Delta-m² approximately 7.3 eV² in the published analysis

results.summary: A sterile-mixing signal was claimed by the collaboration; the result is disputed and must not be treated as an established discovery.
The independent KATRIN beta-spectrum search strongly challenged the claimed preferred parameter region.
